name: Moribe Jun
source:
Birthday: March 25, 2010 (Aries)
Blood Type: O+
Occupation: Member #4 of the Rokumei City Fire Department's Special Elite Rescue Squad "SIRIUS"
Rank: Firefighter
Intelligence: Average
Physical Strength: High
Hobbies: All kinds of sports, patchwork
Likes: Effort, friendship, justice, honesty, being thanked by those she resuces, heroes, rock music, "Sis"
Dislikes: Hesitation, cowardice, betrayal, lies
Enneagram: Type 8 "The Challenger"

A rookie rescue worker. She's still a greenhorn, but no one can surprass her when it comes to passion.

She admires heroes of justice who defeated the strong and protected the weak, so she wants to become one.

Having becoming an elite firefighter and rescue worker at her young age shows that she has outstanding talent much like [url=/c14509]Kazami[/url].

She is incredibly dexterous. Her nimble fingers allow her to free people trapped in machinery and untangle any mess of rope or cable during a mission when seconds count.

Though it clashes with her image, she's taken up knitting as a hobby to improve her dexterity skills.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/root-double-before-crime-after-days-xtend-edition]Kickstarter[/url]]
